Figure 3: LLM scaling methods degrade on harder PBEBench-Lite instances. Accuracy (left) and average token usage (right) of Best-of-K (BoK) and Direct Feedback (DF) scaling strategies applied to gpt-oss-120b, broken down by cascade length on PBEBench-Lite. Both methods solve cascade-length-2 tasks perfectly but collapse at length 5: BoK accuracy drops to 79.3% and DF to 74.6%, while token usage explodes — DF consumes an average of 285K tokens per task at length 5 (13× more than at length 2), and BoK consumes 160K tokens (9× more). This shows that harder instances trigger more LLM attempts, compounding both cost and error.
